_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Initial width of the docked chat panel on desktop when the app opens.
examples: hide the chat when the app opens
settings.notes: At most 100 when the unit is %.

settings.description: On phones, draw the chat transcript edge to edge behind the status and navigation bars.
examples: edge to edge chat on my phone
stop the chat going behind the status bar

settings.description: How far from the top of the screen, in pixels, a pull-down gesture must start to refresh the page.
examples: pull to refresh triggers too easily

excluded./development/**: Development-only live UI switch; not offered to the composer.
